Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
With Psyche!'s new interrupt effect, and the ruling about untapping happening
at strike resolution, I just wanted to make sure what would hypothetically
happen when Mummify and Psyche! intersected (assuming people actually played
with Mummify).

So Vampire A plays Mummify (and Vampire B strikes with hands or something). The
S:CE resolves at the same time that Vampire A untaps. Once combat is over,
someone Psyches! So that means that Vampire A does *not* go to torpor, the
Mummify card is not placed on him, etc. Right?

Halcyan 2
